_comment: Deliberate re-baseline of every arm's wire freeze, 2026-11-23: the move from MCP TypeScript SDK 1.29.0 (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk) to the split SDK v2 packages (@modelcontextprotocol/server 2.4.0, ext-apps 2.0.4). No metadata changed. The SDK changed two things in every tools/list, on every arm: each schema's `$schema` URI moves from draft-07 to 2020-12 (5 chars longer per schema), and every tool loses `execution: {taskSupport: "forbidden"}`, which v2 no longer emits by default. Proof that nothing else moved: per arm, the v1 tools/list with exactly those two changes applied (`v1_normalised`) hashes identical to the v2 tools/list (`after`). Server instructions are byte-identical on every arm. No input or output schema crosses a measured host cut: the closest is best's render_table input schema, 4,861 -> 4,866 chars, under the 5,000 cut (HD2). Earlier results measured on these arms are unaffected: what the model reads (descriptions, field names, describes, enums, instructions, responses) is unchanged. Confirmed after the deploy with a smoke re-run of `best` (see smoke_rerun). The host-probe instruments in evals/host-probe/ stay on SDK 1.29.0 (pinned devDependency) so HD/HD2 remain reproducible.
host_side_check: mcp-compat-check --json on rich: local SDK v2 server vs the deployed SDK v1 function (europe-west4 .../mcp), 2026-11-23. 44 of 44 per-tool, per-client verdicts identical; tools/list 104,750 -> 104,520 chars.
protocol_2026_07_28: Not part of the freeze: the freeze hashes the 2025-era path every eval ran on. On 2026-07-28 (HTTP via createMcpHandler, stdio via serveStdio) tools/list is deep-equal to the 2025 one, same characters and length, but the SDK serialises `$schema` first in each schema, and the list result adds `_meta.io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo`, `ttlMs: 0` and `cacheScope: "private"`. Instructions identical across eras. Host delivery on 2026-07-28 is unmeasured.

smoke_rerun.notes: All three made one get_building_profile call, declined the ratio and named calculated vs measured. One also flagged the 1.77x area-basis gap (f_ga vs BAG oppervlakte).
